title: lolium perenne var. multiflorum
intro: Lolium perenne var. multiflorum, commonly known as Italian ryegrass, is a perennial grass species that is widely distributed across Europe and North Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Italian ryegrass include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Italian ryegrass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antispasmodic, and anti-hypertensive effects.
